correctness.rationale: Write each c_i=d_i*k^{v_i} with k not dividing d_i. For separated normalized starts t_i=e_i+v_i, each summand has a bounded digit block whose initial/terminal digits are nonzero; sufficiently long zero runs uniquely mark blocks and recover the multiset of (d_i,t_i). All nonseparated or boundary tuples number O(L^{r-1}) in the logarithmic exponent cube; interior collision orbits are precisely free permutations of starts within the equal d classes, each of size product_d m_d!. Positivity gives both cutoff sandwich bounds. For (1,3) binary digit patterns partition into singleton, 101, 111 and separate adjacent-pair/one-bit classes, giving L(L-2). Independent exact finite enumerations corroborate; no composite-base primality assumption or nonpositive coefficients are smuggled in.
